topic: Introduction to circuit breakers and various protection provided by circuit breakers
syllabus_extract: Introduction to circuit breakers and various protection provided by circuit breakers.
specific_objectives: 19.1.1.1Trainee will be able to explain aircraft wiring and Causes of wiring degradation.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of CB operation and inspection; Safety: Do not reset blown CBs without fault isolation; Supervision: Instructor verifies fault identification before reset.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of a circuit breaker in an aircraft?
List three common causes of aircraft wiring degradation.
Why are circuit breakers preferred over fuses in modern aircraft?

topics: Definition and basic construction of circuit breakers
Types of circuit breakers used in aircraft systems
Mechanism of thermal and magnetic tripping
Standard locations and identification of CBs
Visual inspection criteria for CB integrity
development.content:
Definition and basic construction of circuit breakers
Types of circuit breakers used in aircraft systems
Mechanism of thermal and magnetic tripping
Standard locations and identification of CBs
Visual inspection criteria for CB integrity

topics: Causes of wiring degradation including chafing and corrosion
Impact of degraded wiring on circuit protection
Relationship between wire condition and CB operation
Common failure modes in aircraft electrical systems
Preventive maintenance measures for wiring integrity
development.content:
Causes of wiring degradation including chafing and corrosion
Impact of degraded wiring on circuit protection
Relationship between wire condition and CB operation
Common failure modes in aircraft electrical systems
Preventive maintenance measures for wiring integrity

topics: Procedures for resetting circuit breakers safely
When to replace a circuit breaker permanently
development.content:
Procedures for resetting circuit breakers safely
Troubleshooting steps after CB trip
Documentation requirements for CB resets
When to replace a circuit breaker permanently
Coordination with other protection systems

summary_questions: Explain how a degraded wire can cause a circuit breaker to trip unnecessarily.
Describe the correct procedure for investigating a tripped circuit breaker before resetting it.
Identify two signs of wiring degradation that require immediate maintenance action.
home_assignment_question: Review the aircraft wiring diagram for your assigned station and identify three circuit breakers; prepare a brief note on their associated systems and potential degradation risks to discuss in LP 05.
